europe_now.title: Ceuta migration crisis
europe_now.summary: The EU has responded to a surge of migrants crossing into Ceuta, with the commissioner describing the incident as a test of European solidarity. Spain has blamed criminal networks for the mass crossing and the EU has offered support to manage the situation.

sources.headline: ‘Europe passed the test’ of Ceuta crisis, says EU commissioner
Spain blames ‘criminal mafias’ for Ceuta mass border crossing as EU offers ‘solidarity’

europe_now.title: Heatwave stresses European nuclear plants
europe_now.summary: A heatwave has put nuclear power plants in Romania, Hungary and France under stress, prompting concerns about safety and energy supply. The high temperatures are testing the resilience of these facilities amid rising climate pressures.

sources.headline: Romania, Hungary, France... Europe's nuclear power plants tested by heatwave

top_stories.title: Drone attack on Ukrainian vendor
top_stories.summary: A Ukrainian street vendor was targeted by a drone that detonated near him, causing injuries. The incident highlights the ongoing use of drones in the conflict.

sources.headline: Ukrainian vegetable seller targeted in 'human safari' drone attack
Ukraine: Drone follows man before detonating and injuring him

top_stories.title: Moscow restaurant bombing
top_stories.summary: A bombing at a Moscow restaurant has sparked nationalist fury and raised concerns about security failures. The attack has prompted discussions about elite privilege and war support.

sources.headline: Moscow restaurant bombing sparks pro-war nationalist fury over elite privilege and security failures

top_stories.title: Togo weapons entry point
top_stories.summary: Togo has become a new entry point for weapons sent by Russia to Mali, according to a France24 report. The development raises questions about regional security and arms trafficking.
